en.headline: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING | BACKEND SYSTEMS | B2B PRODUCT DATA
en.profile: Computer Engineering MSc student at Aarhus University building backend services, data pipelines and web products with Rust, Kubernetes and PostgreSQL. Experience processing 52.9 million historical price observations and connecting supplier documentation, product information and retail workflows through a B2B internship.

skills.label: Backend & data
skills.text: Rust (Axum, Tokio, SQLx), Python, Java, SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs

skills.label: Infrastructure & web
skills.text: Kubernetes (k3s), Docker, Linux, Git, Cloudflare, React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS

experience.title: Backend & Data Engineering
bullets: Built marketplace APIs and React interfaces; shipped autocomplete in Rust (Axum, Tokio, SQLx) and deployed the website on Cloudflare.
Reduced home-feed median latency from 6.9 s to 26 ms and raised throughput from 1.3 to 284 requests/s using edge caching and request coalescing (September 2026 test, 8 concurrent requests).
Configured Kubernetes (k3s) API overflow, health-based failover and PostgreSQL writer/replica separation for consistent writes and distributed reads.
Imported 52.9 million historical price observations from 951 archives into 32 PostgreSQL monthly partitions, validating row counts and preserving source hashes.
Automated daily snapshots of 624,798 product/variant rows and 510,593 distinct products; linked provider data to retail-facing catalog and pricing APIs through transactional, retryable imports.

experience.title: B2B Software Development Internship
bullets: Mapped product-data handoffs, documentation ownership and data quality across suppliers, companies and retailers for Digital Product Passport readiness.
Built an interactive assessment website with purchasing and sales paths, product-data mapping and actionable results; iterated the sprint prototype with stakeholder feedback.

experience.title: Java Software Developer - Internship
bullets: Built JavaFX dashboards for 3 simulated industrial machines, integrating Modbus TCP acquisition with timestamped measurements in MySQL.

experience.title: Communications Assistant - Digital Education
bullets: Coordinated digital communication, event activities and reporting with international youth-education partners.

education.title: MSc Computer Engineering
education.detail: Distributed Systems and Security; Modelling and Verification; Software Correctness.

education.title: BSc Computer Engineering
education.detail: Programming, algorithms, operating systems, networks, databases and software engineering.

additional: Languages: Italian (native), English (C1), Danish (studying toward B1, A2B Sprogskole).
Certificates: Cambridge C1 Advanced; Docker Foundations; Google Git and GitHub; IBM Cybersecurity Fundamentals; AWS Cloud Technical Essentials.
